title: Answer: no positive account of information, and cognition is not information processing

statements.text: Enactivism gives no positive account of information. It denies that cognition is affectless information processing and holds that sense-making is co-constituted by the world in ways that go far beyond the processing of information.

sources.quote: in ways that go far beyond the processing of information
treated cognition as if it were largely affectless problem solving or information processing
